svg.title: Another pair of eyes
svg.desc: Questions drawn from my observation reflection and next steps. Notice. Who is receiving my attention?. Who may be quietly stuck?. Pause. Is the pace right for the class?. What needs more explanation?. Check. What can every student explain. or do independently?. Revisit. What would students’ responses. tell me to change next?
